priya_k: FYI — Acme renewal in 2 weeks. They've asked to rebaseline pricing after POC showed ~2x token usage. Also security QA flagged data residency + SAML/SCIM work. Need deal desk + legal signoff. @janine_legal @ravi_finance @chloe_revops
marco_se: POC metrics: avg prompt 120t, avg completion 350t, KV cache hit ~18%. Total tokens in POC ~1.2T over 30d -> projected monthly run rate. We can reduce spend with 4-bit quant + smarter batching. Ballpark: ~25% cost down but slight perf variance.
priya_k: Customer asked for 20% off list for 12mo commit, wants dedicated pools + pinned model. They also want SOC archive + 7yr retention (legal ask).
janine_legal: Need exact language on data residency, breach notif SLA, and DPA redlines. I'm open to 20% only if commit >= $250k ARR and standard DPA + SOC included. Otherwise escalate.
chloe_revops: If we structure as 12mo with quarterly true-ups we can offer 18% (not 20%). Need usage bands for overage and PO cadence.
ravi_finance: Finance view: 18% + net30 invoices OK with $250k ARR commit. Anything >25% requires CRO approval. Also no net-negative margin.
priya_k: Can we do 18% + dedicated burst option? They want an extra month to extend POC timeline before full switchover.
marco_se: Tech tradeoffs: dedicated pool + 8k ctx model adds ~15% infra cost. Proposal: present two options — (A) Shared hosted + 18% with 12mo commit; (B) Dedicated pool + 12% discount + explicit latency SLOs and a higher min commit. Also include quantized model option to hit cost targets.

priya_k: Customer deadline EOW for countersign. Action items: Janine finalize DPA by Thu, Ravi confirm finance terms by Thu COB, Marco provide SLO + perf delta numbers by Wed. I'll prep quote with A/B options.
chloe_revops: I'll stage both quote variants in CPQ with usage bands and add T&Cs. @deal-desk-bot mark DD-4739 as expedite.
deal-desk-bot: Status updated: DD-4739 — expedited. Approvals pending.
ravi_finance: Confirmed: finance provisionally approves 18% contingent on signed DPA and $250k ARR commit. Payment terms = net30, quarterly true-ups.
priya_k: Great. I'll share options with Acme tomorrow AM and call out timelines. Thanks team :thumbsup:
